# Check before you leave

Look at the screensaver timeout and the display-off timeout. If either is shorter than 40 minutes, raise or disable it for the run.
**Screensaver:** if it fires after 10 minutes of idle, the run dies at minute 10.

| Setting | Check |
|---|---|
| Screensaver timeout | Longer than 40 minutes? |
| Display sleep | Longer than 40 minutes? |
What is your screen saver's wait time set to? And the timeout for display sleep?

fail.answer: It should take about 40 minutes, and Claude will be clicking the whole time.
Claude's input doesn't reset the idle timer, so something may interrupt the run.
